sources.teaching_note: RNA measurements establish transcriptional state, while independent staining measures cell density. Neither directly records the surviving network's electrical activity. Functional experiments are needed to test how altered cell composition changes communication, rather than assuming that every molecular difference has the same circuit consequence.

sources.caption: Human 3D microglia engulf synaptic material. Klimmt (2026).
sources.teaching_note: A lower synaptic-marker signal can arise through several biological changes. It does not by itself identify which cell removed a synapse or whether the synapse was already failing. Establishing an engulfment mechanism requires direct evidence of the relevant cell collecting identified synaptic material.
